{{Quote|Lope, I know you’re in here somewhere. Where are you, you double-dealing slime?|Pezzle|<ref name="CoD" />}}
'''Pezzle''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Karfeddion/Legends|Karfeddion]]. One day he entered [[the Tipsy Mynock]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] to collect payment from a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] named [[Lope (individual)|Lope]]. To demonstrate Lope's worthiness to accompany [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Arwen Cohl]] on a [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]] attack on the [[Eriadu Trade Summit]], Lope [[Death/Legends|killed]] Pezzle and his three companions with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]].<ref name="CoD" />
